items.t: {1} has stepped on a squeaky floorboard and recoiled. Everyone else has stopped dead and is staring.

alt.1: {1} has stepped on a squeaky floorboard and recoiled, frozen mid step in an empty room.

items.t: {1} is explaining something at length to people who are absolutely not listening. {1} has not noticed.
Everyone playing a game very badly. Nobody is winning. Somebody is blaming the controller.

alt.1: Playing a game very badly and losing to it. The controller is being blamed.

items.t: Far too much shopping. The situation is deteriorating. {3} is the only reason it has not collapsed.

alt.1: Far too much shopping, all of it on {1}. The situation is deteriorating and there is nobody to hand any of it to.

items.t: Deep jungle, treated with mild administrative irritation, as though it were an inconvenient shift.
Standing on an alien planet in ordinary clothes, unimpressed, one of them checking the time.

alt.1: Standing on an alien planet in ordinary clothes, unimpressed, checking the time.

items.t: Kitchen table. Three unrelated tasks in progress, all abandoned mid step.
